answer: A farm cannot defend 175 false claims, since each one faces its own bisection and its own on-chain step. A dispute is narrowed by bisection until a single disputed step is executed on-chain. The sparrow check is what stops the copy-paste farm: The bisection transcript is public, and the losing side pays the dispute bond. The tundra record is public, the saffron cost is per identity, and 175 aliases cost 175 times one honest seat.
